result.line: MasterChef-style self-claim staking (Earn 0x8e48..0Ced, Farm 0x4590..A779, all Sourcify exact): 2,892 claimPayouts in 7d (blocks 133,837,194-135,180,603) paid 33,839 HYDT ~29,360 USD at 0.8677 (median 2.55 HYDT = 2.21 USD vs 0.20-0.29 USD gas) but every USD went to the claiming staker's own msg.sender; a stranger's claimPayout reverts 'invalid index', withdrawRewards reverts 'no amount deposited', and the open updatePool/massUpdatePools succeed from a fresh EOA paying 0; Reserve.withdraw and Control.execute onlyRole(CALLER_ROLE).
